name: detain/phlix-plugin-jade-theme
description: A deep emerald UI theme for Phlix with luminous jade accent tones
_comment: Why the repositories block exists (family-drift question):
detain/phlix-shared is developed alongside these plugins,
and the vcs entry lets `composer update` resolve shared tags straight
from GitHub instead of depending on a Packagist mirror's freshness.
`composer install` is lock-driven either way, so CI is unaffected.
Whether the nine sibling themes keep or shed the block is a family
call (routed to the family sweep); removing it here unilaterally
would just create the drift this item complains about, mirrored.
